subject: Avatar disconnect/reconnect double-lane and daily cutover contract
oracle: docs/avatar-lifecycle.md (PL-1); this refines PL-1's `suspended` into two explicit sub-states and adds the daily-cutover barrier events/hooks

suspended_sub_states.rule: grace open, in-memory state retained, fast-lane eligible; reattach inside the grace window returns to active without a reload
cleanup armed, only the slow lane remains, flush in progress; reattach is refused (AVATAR_SUSPENDED), the timeout cleanup chain runs

fast_lane.condition: reattach within grace AND hosting generation still current AND no intervening writer AND in-memory state retained
fast_lane.result: suspended-waiting -> active, no reload, no tombstone
fast_lane.catch_up: if the durable cursor advanced while suspended (save/timer ran), catch up via PropertySync baseline + gapless deltas, or replay the ordered change journal (oplog), before the avatar resumes

slow_lane.condition: grace expired OR generation changed OR in-memory state lost
slow_lane.result: suspended-waiting -> suspended-expiring -> reclaiming -> closed -> loading -> active (reload from durable record; generation advances only if a transfer intervened)
slow_lane.never: a reconnect never resurrects a closed avatar; re-entry always goes through loading

three_reconnect_paths.name: fast_reattach
steps: verdict: grace open + generation current + no intervening writer

three_reconnect_paths.name: grace_expired_reload
steps: timeout cleanup chain (leave broadcast, ref release, recycle bin, tombstone)

three_reconnect_paths.name: kick_on_relogin
steps: new session logs in while avatar active
old avatar -> suspended-waiting (or refused if mid-transfer)
new session reattaches (fast lane); never two active writable avatars

three_layer_touch_order.name: avatar
three_layer_touch_order.detail: per-avatar: freeze handlers/ticks, avatar_save (write barrier, durable ACK), onAvatarDailyReset(context), resume

three_layer_touch_order.name: scene
three_layer_touch_order.detail: per-instance: onDailyReset(context) for instance state, only after every avatar in the instance flushed

three_layer_touch_order.name: node
three_layer_touch_order.detail: node-level maintenance barrier release / daily tick, only after all avatars and instances flushed

daily_cutover.touch_guarantee: bottom-up: avatar layer before scene layer before node layer; each layer's write barrier completes before the next begins; within a layer, deterministic order by identity
daily_cutover.write_barrier: the flush (avatar_save durable ACK) is the barrier; a hook failure after the flush does not roll it back or re-dirty the flushed state

failure_compensation.interruption: save fails at the avatar layer
failure_compensation.compensation: retry within budget; barrier held; no partial cutover published; surface to operator

failure_compensation.interruption: hook fails at the avatar layer
failure_compensation.compensation: logged; the flush is the barrier and already durable; the cutover proceeds (the hook is post-barrier)
no layer advances; a partial cutover is never published; recovery resumes the barrier

hook_signatures.onAvatarDailyReset: (context) -> nothing; called per active/visiting avatar after its avatar_save flushed durable; failure is logged and the flush stands
hook_signatures.onDailyReset: (context) -> nothing; called per scene instance after every avatar in it flushed; failure is logged and retried within the barrier
